seo.meta_description: 2025 Audi A6 Avant import from Japan for NZ buyers. 2.0 diesel quattro wagon, auction-backed sourcing, pricing guidance and import support.
seo.og_title: 2025 Audi A6 Avant import from Japan to NZ
seo.og_description: Looking at a 2025 Audi A6 Avant? We help NZ buyers source cars from Japanese auctions, explain the auction list, check viability and guide the import process.
secondary_keywords: Audi A6 Avant import from Japan
Audi A6 Avant diesel wagon import

blocks.hero_subtitle: The 2025 Audi A6 Avant brings together the road manners of an executive car with the everyday usefulness of a proper wagon. The 40 TDI quattro is a strong fit for buyers who want diesel torque, all-wheel-drive confidence and generous luggage space without moving to an SUV.
proof_points: Japan specialists with direct auction access
Importing estimate provided before bidding, with compliance as part of the process
blocks.why_kiwis_buy: The appeal is fairly straightforward. You get a prestige wagon with real luggage space, quattro for wet roads, and a diesel that makes 400Nm without needing to be worked hard. Paired with the 7-speed S tronic, the model-level setup suits buyers who want easy long-distance pace and a more responsive feel than a conventional torque-converter auto.
blocks.video_caption: From the front three-quarter angle you can see why the A6 Avant still has a following. The long roof, short overhangs and low stance give it the carrying ability of a wagon without losing the shape people buy an Audi for in the first place.
blocks.main_usp_deep: The main draw with this model is that it does several jobs at once without feeling compromised. The DTY 2.0-litre diesel turbo makes 204PS, about 201hp, and 400Nm, which is enough to move a car of this size with very little fuss, and that 400Nm is the number that matters because it gives the car its easy mid-range shove. quattro is part of the appeal as well, especially for buyers who spend time on wet motorways or mixed South Island roads where a wagon with secure traction feels more settled. Then there is the body style itself, a proper Avant gives you the load space and access of a wagon while keeping the lower driving position and quieter road manners that draw people away from SUVs.

buyer_persona.headline: Who is this car right for?
buyer_persona.body: This suits someone who wants executive comfort, a useful boot and a more composed long-distance car than a tall SUV. It also makes sense for buyers who want quiet, refined motorway travel but do not want to be disappointed by finding the wrong trim or option mix after the car arrives, which is why we confirm the exact auction car before bidding. If you want a prestige wagon with diesel torque and all-wheel drive, this is a solid match.

car_specs_benefits.benefit: A 2.0-litre diesel of this size suits the A6 Avant well, giving strong pulling power without needing high revs.
That output is enough for confident overtaking and relaxed motorway pace in a full-size wagon.
This is the figure you feel day to day, less throttle needed when joining traffic or climbing hills with passengers and luggage.
The transmission gives quick, clean shifts and helps the car feel more responsive than a softer conventional automatic.
Extra traction is useful in heavy rain and gives the car a more planted feel on mixed NZ roads.

standout_features_block.headline: Features that stand out
standout_features_block.intro: Exact equipment varies by auction car, so these are the features worth confirming because they make the biggest difference in daily use.

items.title: S line trim package
items.body: S line is more than a badge, it is the trim many buyers target because it changes the look and cabin feel of the A6 Avant. On an individual car, we confirm the exact S line items listed or visible before you bid, rather than assuming every car has the same package content.
items.image_hint: Front seats, steering wheel and dashboard showing the sportier S line cabin treatment

items.title: Driver-assist equipment by exact car
items.body: Cars in this class can be fitted with useful assistance features, but option content varies and it is worth checking the exact listing rather than relying on the model name. We confirm what is actually listed or visible, especially if adaptive cruise, parking cameras or other assist systems matter to you.
items.image_hint: Dashboard screen or steering wheel controls showing active driver-assist menus

items.title: Avant wagon body
items.body: The body style is a feature in itself. A6 Avant buyers want the lower loading height and easier boot access that a wagon gives, without moving into a taller SUV shape.
items.image_hint: Rear tailgate open with the boot area visible and luggage loaded

items.title: Factory option mix worth checking
items.body: Audio, wheel size and comfort equipment can vary quite a bit between cars that look similar on paper. That is why we confirm the exact trim, listed options and visible equipment on the auction car before a bid is approved.
items.image_hint: Interior dashboard and centre console showing factory screen, controls and trim finish

tech_deep_dive_block.headline: Under the skin
tech_deep_dive_block.intro: This is the engineering side that makes the A6 Avant feel the way it does.

items.title: DTY 2.0-litre diesel turbo
items.body: The confirmed engine here is the DTY 1,968cc diesel turbo, rated at 204PS, about 201hp, and 400Nm. In a car like the A6 Avant, the torque figure matters more than the power headline because it is what gives the car that easy, low-effort surge from everyday revs. That suits the brief of a large executive wagon, especially if the car will spend time carrying adults, luggage or both.

items.title: 7-speed S tronic
items.body: Audi's S tronic is a dual-clutch transmission, so it shifts through pre-selected gears rather than relying on the softer feel of a traditional automatic. Behind the wheel that means cleaner, quicker responses when you ask for acceleration. It is one of the reasons this diesel A6 does not feel lazy despite being tuned for torque rather than outright performance.

items.title: quattro drivetrain
items.body: quattro is a big part of why buyers look for this version instead of a front-wheel-drive wagon. The practical point is simple, it gives the car more secure traction and a more settled feel when conditions turn wet. For NZ use, that matters on long motorway trips and mixed-surface driving.

blocks.how_to_use_iyc: Send us the model, year, budget and the features that matter to you. We check current auction availability, confirm whether the exact vehicle looks viable to import, explain the auction list and provide an indicative landed-cost calculation before any live bid is placed. If the numbers or the car do not stack up, we will say so.

faq_block.q: Can you confirm the exact spec on a 2025 Audi A6 Avant before I bid?
faq_block.a: Yes, that is one of the main steps before bidding. We confirm the exact model code, trim, engine code, listed equipment and the condition notes shown on the auction list for that vehicle.

faq_block.q: What costs make up the landed price?
faq_block.a: The main components are Vehicle cost; Japan-side costs; Shipping costs; Customs clearance; Compliance; and On-road costs. We provide an indicative calculation before you approve a bid.

faq_block.q: Does a clean auction list mean the car is typically within the entry requirements?
faq_block.a: No. Import viability must be checked for the exact model code and vehicle before bidding, and final certification occurs in NZ after arrival and inspection.

faq_block.q: How long does the process take?
faq_block.a: Timing depends on when a suitable car appears, the shipping schedule and the NZ arrival process. We keep you updated through purchase, shipping and arrival rather than guessing a fixed date up front.

faq_block.q: How much can the auction list tell me about condition?
faq_block.a: It can tell you a lot, but not everything. We translate and explain the recorded grade, mileage, damage markings, condition notes and listed modifications, and we also tell you what the available information does not show.

If you would rather sit high like an SUV, the A6 Avant's appeal is the opposite, lower, quieter and more car-like.

engine_drivetrain_block.headline: Powertrain overview
engine_drivetrain_block.body: The confirmed model-level setup is the 40 TDI quattro. That means Audi's DTY 2.0-litre diesel turbo with 204PS, about 201hp, and 400Nm, paired with a 7-speed S tronic and quattro all-wheel drive. For the buyer, that translates to easy mid-range performance, quick transmission response and secure traction in poor weather. Exact trim and option content still need to be confirmed on the individual auction car.
